newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Rebel chief says Zaire rebels nearing Kinshasa.
newsitem.headline: Rebel chief says Zaire rebels nearing Kinshasa.

text.p: Rebel leader Laurent Kabila said on Tuesday rebel "elements" had reached a town only 270 km (170 miles) northeast of the Zairean capital Kinshasa.
"We are in Kasai Oriental. Elements have arrived in Bandundu and Mbandaka," Kabila said without elaborating. Kasai Oriental is the eastern part of Kasai region with Mbuji-Mayi as its capital.
Bandundu is a major town 270 km (170 miles) northwest of Kinshasa. Mbandaka is 600 km (375 miles) northwest of the capital.

At a rally in Mbuji-Mayi, stronghold of veteran opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi, Kabila did not go as far as to say either town was captured. Such an advance by a large force from eastern Zaire in such a short time appeared unlikely.
Mbuji-Mayi, Zaire's diamond capital, fell without a fight to Kabila's Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire last Friday and is 950 km (590 miles) southeast of Kinshasa.
